nodes.question: What was the specific emission factor for cargo ship emissions in the apparel manufacturing industry?
nodes.answer: Cargo ship emissions in the apparel manufacturing industry were found to be 50.9 grams of CO2 equivalents per TEU-km, based on data from BSR in 2015.
